review.issue: SPLIT_QK predicate uses padded BLOCK_D==128 rather than requiring actualD==128; unmasked splitK loads can exceed actual channel bounds and MASK_KV path uses undefined kv_mask. Original fourD128 cases have not yet been evaluated.
review.requested_repair: Require actualD==128 in the same metadata predicate, preserve all other candidate computations/paths. No new operator tests.

input.command: ls -la actual-ir; echo ---; head -60 actual-ir/*.ttir 2>/dev/null | head -100

review.issue: Flat V conversion preserves BSND storage but final PV addresses it as BNSD with v_base=(b*NKV+kvh)*(SKV*D) and rowstrideD. For original contiguous V the same (b,kvh,n,d) element instead has sequence strideNKV*D. This changes the mathematical input V. No device evaluation has started.
review.requested_repair: Preserve flat contiguous V conversion and its BSND ordering. Fix only final PV V16 address interpretation and matching comments to read original BSND strideNKV*D. Keep allthree stage mechanics, originalFP16 fallback and scratch ownership. No new tests.
review.evidence_corrections: Model actualTTIR read was first60lines only; no actual BCMLIR read logged. Diagnose mixedcore handoffs from source/profiling/simulator; TTIR prefix shows programgeometry and K/V layout only. Partialwindow ratios support a localhypothesis; no fullcall criticalpath conclusion. NormalizedFP16 weights have rounding/underflow risks and need officialchecker.
